name: Excavation Site: Wetlands
summary: On top of Whelgar's Excavation Site in the Wetlands. Raptors overran the camp, and there is titan activity nearby.

abilities.name: Tendon Rip
abilities.note: Slows the tank's movement, no effect on the fight.

abilities.name: Dust Storm
abilities.note: Hits within 10 yards, lowers hit chance by 25%. Stay out.

tactics.general: Easy if the nearby mobs are cleared. Dust Storm hits everyone within 10 yards and lowers hit chance, so casters stay out of melee.
tactics.dps: Ranged stay more than 10 yards away.

abilities.name: Terrifying Roar
abilities.note: 5 second fear, not dispellable. Ranged and healer stay back.

abilities.name: Enrage
abilities.note: At 30% he hits harder and faster. Stuns and slows still work.

tactics.general: Hard if you rush it. Two Thicket Hunters come with him, crowd control them or kill one at a time while the other is controlled. Fight him in the crocodile cove on the left after clearing it, so fears don't send people into raptors in the grass. Hunters can't swim, so don't use the water by the previous boss or he resets. He can be stunned and slowed, which helps a lot during his enrage at 30%.
tactics.tank: Clear the crocodile cove on the left and tank him there.
tactics.healer: Stay back from his fear. Remove Infected Wound fast.
tactics.dps: Control or kill the Thicket Hunters first. Ranged stay back from the fear.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.note: Hits and slows everyone within 10 yards.

abilities.name: Arcing Smash
abilities.note: Cone in front of him, keep the group behind.

tactics.general: Start by pressing the Archival Panel to the right of the inactive boss. A gear check: big health and big tank damage. Thunderclap hits within 10 yards, the tank gets knocked back and sometimes stunned for 5 seconds. He can be stunned and slowed, so use control often, and you can kite around the structures with a slow.
tactics.tank: Face him away from the group (cone). Expect knockbacks and short stuns.
tactics.dps: Ranged stay more than 10 yards away.
